skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Systematize foundational knowledge about statistical modeling methods.
Evaluate and explain models and results from statistical analysis models.
Explain results from statistical analysis models.
Conduct principal component analysis using statistical software.
Perform correspondence analysis using statistical software.
Execute cluster analysis on various types of data.
Apply multivariate analysis techniques to real-world datasets.
Develop critical thinking skills to evaluate statistical models.
Enhance self-learning abilities to independently study statistical methods.
Improve ability to solve problems collaboratively within a team.
Understand ethical considerations in statistical analysis.
Achieve proficiency in using statistical software for data analysis.
